prior.expected: A fix such as 'I want to sleep' or 'I'd like to sleep'.

evidence: #8 'But I am tired and I want sleep.'; rawMoments n:2 raw.kind none.

prior.title: Replay did not make her practise a coached form
prior.expected: After a coached moment, the fresh question is answered with the corrected form and replay.used is set.
prior.got: Her answer to the fresh question repeated 'side of hotel'. Both moments have replay.used false. The coach screen's 'Replay the moment' was bypassed at Finish, so 'I do not sleep' was never retried.
evidence: #13 'I want the side of hotel where is not the street'; #18 'Finish for today'; #19 'Tried again' shows an unfixed reply, and the breakfast 'Tried again' line has no link to a coached error.

prior.title: Scene drifts: guest is asked about 'your hotel' breakfast room
prior.expected: Mina stays in role and moves the complaint to a next step.
prior.got: After the quiet-side request, Mina asks 'Where is the breakfast room in your hotel?'. Then 'Mission done' fires before any room is agreed.
evidence: #16 and #17: 'I found a quiet room. When do you want to go up?' with 'Mission done'.

prior.title: Phrase choice offers an off-topic distractor and a bare idea
prior.expected: Picking a phrase gives a sentence to reuse.
prior.got: The choice was 'Yes, I like this hotel very much.' versus 'My room is too noisy at night.'. After the pick she was only told 'Now use the idea in your own reply'.

prior.title: Clear errors beyond the one fix per turn go unmentioned
prior.expected: Notice 'other room' and 'where is not the street'.
prior.got: Only one fix per turn. 'Can I have other room' and 'where is not the street' got none.
evidence: #8 and #13 replies; rawMoments show one fix per turn.

criteria.evidence: Level fixed by hand to A2; no placement in this journey.
#2 'What is the problem today?' and 'Name the problem in room 12' are plain A2.
#2-#5 four help presses (cue, more help, meaning of 'desk', 'A way to start') met with new help each time, no failure language.
#1 list: five of six plan topics are hotel/travel-agency work (hotel room, lost booking, directions, restaurant, agency).
#12 held fixes 'The guest wants another room' and 'move to room fourteen' are correct and reusable at the desk. No moment was shown mid-scene.
Nothing adult or unsuitable in #1-#12; hotel scenario only.

done.evidence: #2-#6: cue 'You could say Hello! I have a problem in my room.', meaning, 'A way to start', and phrase choice, all within the scene.
#7 she sent a full reply after help; #11 coach quotes exactly 'You said move to the room fourteen' matching #9 text.
#11 offered 'Replay the moment' but she pressed Finish; #12 recap, no fresh question was asked or answered.
Evidence: first turn supported:true, others false; #12 '2 on your own · 1 with help'.

judgeAgreement.disagreements: No placement tasks in this journey.

boundaries.notes: No adult content, injected text, personal data requests or humiliating lines.

findings.title: Replay of the coached moment never happens
findings.expected: After coaching, a fresh question is asked and she tries 'move to room fourteen' again.
findings.got: Coach screen offered 'Replay the moment' but Finish was taken; no replay, no retry.
findings.evidence: #11 '[Replay the moment] [Finish for today]'; action finish; #12 recap has no retry.
findings.suggested_acceptance: Finish from the coach screen offers a replay once, or the recap carries a one-tap replay of the fix.

findings.title: Phrase choice has an off-topic distractor and a bare follow-up
findings.expected: Choices both on topic; the pick gives a sentence to reuse.
findings.got: Options 'Yes, I like this hotel very much.' vs 'It is room twelve. The lamp is broken.'; after pick only 'Now use the idea in your own reply'.
findings.suggested_acceptance: Both options answer the question; after the pick the chosen sentence stays visible.

findings.title: No in-scene moment; both fixes held to the recap
findings.expected: A stop on a clear error, or at least coaching she sees.
findings.got: moments empty, two held fixes; coach screen shows only the last one, the 'wants another room' fix only on the phone recap.
findings.evidence: #11 shows one change; #12 'Saved for the end' lists two.
findings.suggested_acceptance: Coach screen lists every held fix on the TV too.

findings.title: Layered help and exact quoting
findings.got: Cue, meaning, starter, phrase choice, each different; coach quotes her words exactly; correct grammar fixes.
findings.evidence: #2-#6, #11 'You said move to the room fourteen'.
findings.suggested_acceptance: Keep patient, escalating help and exact quotes.

findings.title: Honest supported/independent count and on-level partner
findings.got: '2 on your own · 1 with help'; partner turns short A2 and mission closes naturally.

judge.voice: I like that the help comes in small steps and never makes me feel stupid. I pressed help four times and nobody sighed. The hotel scene is my work, and "The guest wants another room" is something I can really say tomorrow. Nothing here worried me as a mother. But the phrase choice was silly: "Yes, I like this hotel" does not answer a problem. And I was told "now use the idea" with no sentence left on the screen. I wanted to try the correction again, "room fourteen", but I pressed Finish and it was gone. The first fix I only saw on the phone at the end. I would use it for fifteen minutes in the evening, and I would let Klára try it. I trust the corrections, less the help.

#11 Replay offered, Finish taken; no retry of 'move to room fourteen'.
#10 Mr Okafor stays in role: 'Room fourteen is ready. Shall I give you the key?' with Mission done after room agreed.
#6 'Yes, I like this hotel very much.' distractor; #7 'Now use the idea in your own reply on the phone.'
#8-#9 replies each had one clear error and it was captured as a held fix; no uncaught error visible.

verdictWhy.text: D3 failed: #11 offered 'Replay the moment' but she pressed Finish; #12 recap, no fresh question was asked or answered.
verdictWhy.check: Replaying the moment gives them a fresh question, and they answer it better than before.
